scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “Sharpness of the Cyclic Integral Floer Bound Below the Stable Morse Number” (preprints/Sharpness-of-the-Cyclic-Integral-Floer-Bound-Below-the-Stable-Morse-Number-October-5-2026/sharp-cyclic-integral-floer-bound-below-stable-morse-number.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 347 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b9fec0a6b56d3a8d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There exist a simply connected closed Kähler manifold (M, ω) of complex dimension 1666 and a smooth one-periodic Hamiltonian H such that c1(TM)(π2(M)) = Z, every fixed point of ϕ1 H is nondegenerate, and # Fix(ϕ1 H) = # Fix0(ϕ1 H; H) = βcyc Z (M) = 1 872 232, SM(M) = βcyc Z (M) + 32 = 1 872 264.
